ownerApproval: Owner approved automating the sign-in with a disposable Keycloak user and this label on 2026-10-21.
method: deploy/acceptance/oauth-issuer/authorize-playwright.mjs drives the real Keycloak login and consent pages in Chromium as the runtime-generated interop user (credentials.json, 0600); DCR + authorization code + PKCE + code exchange reuse authorize.mjs. Chromium trusts only the fixture leaf by SPKI pin; Node trusts the fixture CA via NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS. No password grant, no synthesized JWT, no TLS bypass.
fixtureFix: authorize.mjs no longer sends a registration scope: Keycloak replaced the realm default zenith-binding (audience + member claim) with the listed optional scopes, so tokens lacked aud and zenith_subject and were correctly rejected. The authorization request still asks for read/plan/logs.
environment: Native Darwin ARM64, Node 22.23.3; owned disposable Keycloak 26.4.7 fixture (compose project zenith-oauth-ux02-a7f3) removed afterwards; protected services untouched.
limits: The Zenith-side Integrations grant was not exercised. Ran at the delegated worktree commit 63b26a58; the same change is on the branch as 3bd85fae.
